new_issues.title: A stale sed backup copy CoreServiceFactory.test.ts-E was committed.
new_issues.why: The diff adds packages/core/tests/services/CoreServiceFactory.test.ts-E (blob e6539010, the pre-change test) with one-argument createContextPipeline calls. Vitest includes only tests/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,...} and core tsconfig includes only src/**, so the file is never run or typechecked. Dead clutter worth deleting, but it causes no wrong behavior.

new_issues.title: Plain (non-AdoptionError) failures in the adoption step fall into the generic catch and return the error-stub context instead of failing the build.
new_issues.why: True at head: generateContextFromProject rethrows only PermissivenessFragmentError and AdoptionError; plain errors from readAdoptionState (malformed TOML), readHistory, presentPaths/recognizeCi (non-ENOENT) or the guide read become getErrorContext's stub, and the new comment 'Errors propagate' is inaccurate. But the stub-on-error catch predates the diff, malformed .context-forge.toml already produced the stub via resolveIntegrationBranchForPrompt before this change, the stub visibly carries the error text rather than posing as a concept prompt, and the remaining triggers are rare I/O failures. A contract/comment mismatch worth tightening, not a merge-blocking defect on its own (the real harm in this area, the in_progress write before the probes, is the separate known bug which no finding names).

new_issues.title: context_build keeps idempotentHint: true although a first brownfield build writes adoption.state.
new_issues.why: context_build is annotated readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true. MCP's idempotentHint means repeated calls with the same arguments have no additional effect on the environment. The first brownfield build writes in_progress; a repeat call reads in_progress, the outcome is adoption-in-progress, stateSetByBuild is false and nothing more is written. The environment effect is idempotent; only the output's one-time notice differs, which the hint does not cover.

new_issues.title: template_preview claims no side effects but generateContext still runs ensureGuideForProject, which can initialize the guide submodule.
new_issues.why: ensureGuideForProject in generateContext and template_preview's readOnlyHint/description are unchanged context lines in base..head; this diff only added the 'read-only' adoption mode, which does stop the new adoption write. The guide auto-init side effect existed before.

new_issues.title: ContextIntegrator's constructor and generateContext grow more positional parameters instead of an options object.
new_issues.why: True: the constructor now takes seven positional parameters and generateContext gained a second positional adoptionStateWrites. This is an API-style point; all call sites are typed and correct.

new_issues.title: The 'persist'/'read-only' write-mode literals (and adoption state literals) are repeated rather than defined as named constants.
new_issues.why: AdoptionStateWrites is a string-literal union and callers pass 'persist'/'read-only' literally. The union type makes a typo a compile error, so this is a define-once style point with no behavioral effect.

new_issues.title: The new template section key 'adoptionFacts' is camelCase among kebab-case keys.
new_issues.why: The other keys in buildTemplate are kebab-case or single words; 'adoptionFacts' is inconsistent. No code looks sections up by key, so it is naming only.

new_issues.title: Integration tests spread the whole process.env into the spawned CLI.
new_issues.why: The env spread at build.integration.test.ts:96 and the other cited files is not in the base..head diff, which only adds the adoptionStateWrites option to createContextPipeline calls in that test.

new_issues.title: assertGuideSupportsAdoption relies on ContextProfileParser, which only matches 'context_profiles:\n' and so fails on CRLF guides.
new_issues.why: ContextProfileParser's PROFILE_KEY = 'context_profiles:\n' is unchanged by this diff, and ContextIntegrator's existing profile filtering already depends on it. The new resolver is one more caller that would turn a CRLF guide into a misleading 'no profile' AdoptionError, but the defect lives in the unchanged parser and needs a CRLF guide checkout to arise.

new_issues.title: persistInProgress wraps and rethrows the write error without an ERROR log.
new_issues.why: True that nothing is logged before the throw, but the AdoptionError carries the original message and cause and propagates to the CLI/MCP error handler, which reports it. A logging-convention point only.

new_issues.title: Adoption is silently skipped when project.projectPath is absent.
new_issues.why: True for direct library callers, but cf build throws when projectPath is missing and the MCP path also requires it, so no shipped entry point reaches this branch. Speculative hardening.

new_issues.title: The 'implementation' default instruction literal is repeated again at the new adoption step.
new_issues.why: True: line 148 adds another `project.instruction || 'implementation'`, alongside lines 216, 244, 289. All copies currently agree, and when adoption selects, the replaced instruction flows through the spread project, so behavior is correct. Define-once style point.
